issues.problem: mo-both explain illustrated 'particles stay in front of each も' with 朝も夜も, which has no particle
issues.action: replaced with 田中さんとも山田さんとも話しました

issues.problem: mo-both mistake 東京も大阪にも行きました is common, acceptable speech (に often drops before も), not a real error
issues.action: replaced with a polarity mistake: 兄も姉も結婚しています for 'neither is married' -> 結婚していません

issues.problem: mo-total-negation: 誰も会いませんでした is colloquially heard for 'I met no one', so claiming it means 'no one met' overstates; weak illustration
issues.action: explain now uses 誰も話しませんでした ('no one spoke'); mistake replaced with 誰も電話しませんでした -> 誰にも電話しませんでした

issues.problem: mo-total-negation: 'いつも takes a positive verb' is false (いつも + negative is normal)
issues.action: rewrote: いつも simply means 'always', never 'at no time'

issues.problem: mo-also mistake note for 母はお酒も飲みます did not say what the bad sentence actually means
issues.action: note now states the intended meaning and what お酒も would mean

issues.problem: example 1 English 'and so on on the desk' was clumsy
issues.action: changed to 'There are things like books and notebooks on the desk.'
